| **Actuators** | 8 total: 7 `position` actuators for the arm + 1 `general` tendon actuator (`fingers_actuator`, ctrlrange `[0, 255]`) coupling both driver joints via a `split` tendon |
| **EE site** | `pinch_site` (on `bracelet_link`, pointing toward gripper tip) + `pinch` (on gripper `base`) |
| **EE body** | `right_silicone_pad` (leaf body) |
| **Graspable bodies** | None (no free joints in the scene) |
| **Equality constraints** | 3 — two `connect` constraints coupling follower↔coupler on each side, one `joint` equality mirroring left/right driver joints |
